row.name: Magnetic Grip (Cybernetic)
row.effect: Electro-magnets built into the palm and fingers, or the soles of the feet. Hand magnets grant a +3 bonus to resist being disarmed of metal weapons. Foot/Hand magnets allow the user to climb metallic surfaces at half speed, brace against a metal surface to avoid being pulled, blown, or knocked off it (such as during explosive decompression or zero-g combat), and use a firm grip on a metal surface as an improvised anchor point for climbing gear-free ascents.
